[SWS_DM_00385] Acceptance of UDS message reception
⌈
If the DM is
able to process the indicated request, it shall return a std::pair with Indica-
tionResult set to kIndicationOk and a UdsMessagePtr, which owns a valid
UdsMessage object, with a capacity of so many bytes, the DM wants to process of the
indicated request. The minimum size of the UdsMessage object shall be one byte.
⌋
